info.name: TodoFolder
info.summary: One folder, one todo: AI reads the files, fills title, due date and tags, and mirrors it to Deck. 一个文件夹就是一条待办。
info.description:
**English**
TodoFolder turns one Nextcloud folder into a todo list: every subfolder is one todo, and the files inside it are the material.
* Create a workspace that points at an existing folder in Files, for example `/Tasks/Acme`. * Every subfolder of that folder becomes one todo; the files inside are its material. * The app reads file names and text content, calls an OpenAI-compatible model and comes back with the task title, a summary, a due date (relative dates such as "next Friday" or "end of month" work), a priority and tags. * Tags are written as Nextcloud system tags, so they are visible and filterable in Files. * The result can be mirrored to a Nextcloud Deck card (title, description, due date, colour); every workspace binds its own board and column.
Workspaces are private by default and can be shared with groups, read-only or read-write. Scanning runs on a schedule, on demand from the page, or from the command line with `occ todofolder:scan`. The interface, the Deck cards and the generated tasks are available in English and Chinese, following each user's language setting.
---
**中文**
待办夹把 Nextcloud 的一个目录变成待办清单：每个子文件夹就是一条待办，里面的文件是材料。
* 建一个「工作区」，指向 Files 里任意一个已有目录，例如 `/Tasks/客户A`。 * 该目录下每个子文件夹就是一条待办，里面的文件是这条待办的材料。 * 应用读取文件名与文本内容，调用兼容 OpenAI 的模型接口，自动得出任务标题、摘要、截止时间（支持「下周五」「月底」这类相对时间）、优先级与标签。 * 标签写入 Nextcloud 系统标签，在 Files 里可以直接看到并筛选。 * 结果可以单向同步为 Nextcloud Deck 卡片（标题、描述、截止时间、颜色），每个工作区绑定自己的看板与列。
工作区默认私有，也可以显式共享给群组（只读或可写）。扫描既可以由后台任务定时进行，也可以在页面上手动触发，或用 `occ todofolder:scan` 命令行执行。界面、Deck 卡片和生成的任务内容都支持中英双语，跟随每个用户自己的语言设置。
